Site Palette Help: Getting Started, Features, Pricing & FAQ
Site Palette vs Other Color Palette Extensions

name: Site Palette
summary: Browser extension that extracts color palettes from any website and exports them to design tools.
description: Site Palette is a Chrome and Firefox extension that reads the colors of a live web page and builds a palette in Color Cube, Material Design or Median Cut mode. Palettes export to SVG, Sketch template, Adobe Swatch, Google Palette and Coolors, and optional profiles save or share them across devices. The site also publishes comparisons against other palette extensions and a help section covering pricing and subscriptions.
contains: extracts a color palette from any website in the browser
palette modes: Color Cube, Material Design, Median Cut
exports to SVG, Sketch template, Adobe Swatch, Google Palette and Coolors
free to install; a free trial unlocks the full feature set for new users
optional profile saves and shares palettes across devices
